_nota: Contraparte en inglés de habitat_systems.json (2026-11-15): cada cadena castellana que se enseña, con su inglés. Las claves de sistema y de estado no se traducen, y las citas literales de los documentos de la NASA ya estaban en inglés y van tal cual. «nominal» es igual en los dos idiomas y no lleva pareja. Traducción automática, sin revisar por una persona; lo vigila tests/test_habitat_en.py.

strings.Vocabulario de diseño de EMMA: EMMA no m: EMMA design vocabulary: EMMA does not model a specific spacecraft and this list has not been read from any. It is a minimal functional partition of the systems of a habitat and is replaced by that of the real vehicle on deployment. The life support functions it names are in NASA's technical brief on the ECLSS (OCHMO-TB-002), which groups them differently: temperature, humidity, CO2 and trace contaminants go under air revitalization, and oxygen under pressure control. Power, communications and lighting are not part of the ECLSS. Food and exercise are included because two NASA technical briefs call them a system: “The space food system must provide food that is safe, nutritious, and acceptable to the crew” (OCHMO-TB-013 Rev E, p. 1, read on 2026-10-31) and “The vehicle must be designed to accommodate all aspects of the exercise system” (OCHMO-TB-031, Design Considerations, read on 2026-11-01). The active thermal control of the ISS (ATCS) removes the heat of the equipment; cabin air is handled by ECLSS equipment.
strings.declarado por una persona, no telemetría: declared by a person, not telemetry
strings.EMMA no lee el estado de ningún sistema: EMMA does not read the state of any habitat system: what is shown is what a person declared in the console, signed in the ledger. It does not enter any score and does not move levels, alerts or excursions.
strings.La relación entre un sistema y un paráme: The relation between a system and a cabin parameter is one of definition: in this vocabulary the system is defined by what it does with that parameter. It is not a medical claim or a hypothesis of cause.
strings.La lista de sistemas es de diseño de EMM: The list of systems is EMMA's design, but which functions are life support is not: it comes from NASA's technical brief on the ECLSS (OCHMO-TB-002 Rev B, read on 2026-10-21), which says that the ECLSS “provides clean air and water to crew” and “manages air and water quality, waste, atmospheric parameters, and emergency response systems”, and whose subsystem diagram (page 3) includes the temperature and humidity limits [V2 6012]. With that reading, air revitalization, pressure control, thermal and humidity control, contaminant control and water are marked as life support; lighting, power and communications are not. Neither are food and exercise: OCHMO-TB-013 and OCHMO-TB-031 do not call them life support, and OCHMO-TB-002 treats them as a demand on the ECLSS, not as one of its functions. It only serves to propose a system declared degraded or out of service as a candidate common cause when several crew members change at the same time: the document does not say what effect the failure of a specific system has on people.
strings.Un sistema y su estado son identificador: A system and its state are identifiers from this list, not clinical observations: they carry no LOINC code and do not enter the indicator catalogue.
strings.Quien declara dice que el sistema funcio: The person declaring says that the system works as expected.
The person declaring says that the system works, but not as expected.
strings.Quien declara dice que el sistema no fun: The person declaring says that the system does not work.
strings.Nadie ha declarado el estado de este sis: Nobody has declared the state of this system. It does not mean that it works: it is not known.
strings.Retira el CO2 del aire de cabina y repon: Removes CO2 from the cabin air and replenishes the oxygen.
strings.Mantiene la temperatura y la humedad del: Maintains the temperature and humidity of the cabin air.
strings.Retira del aire de cabina los contaminan: Removes trace contaminants from the cabin air.
strings.Genera, almacena y distribuye la energía: Generates, stores and distributes the electrical power of the habitat.
strings.Enlace de voz y datos con Tierra y entre: Voice and data link with Earth and between modules.
strings.Almacena, recupera y distribuye el agua: Stores, recovers and distributes the water of the habitat.
strings.Proporciona a la tripulación comida segu: Provides the crew with safe, nutritious and acceptable food.
strings.Equipo con el que la tripulación hace ej: Equipment with which the crew exercises on board.
